rules.statement: Don't ask to move a pull request's CHANGELOG.md entries from a new dated version section to `[Unreleased]` when the repository's landing conventions have each plan release under its own version and write that version's changelog section in its last step.
rules.why: In such repositories the plan's `Release:` line names the version, the merge commit is tagged and the GitHub release is published from that section after merge, and a renumber step moves the section if another pull request takes the version first.
rules.check: Before reporting, read the `## Landing` section of AGENTS.md (or the equivalent release convention) and the plan's `Release:` line; only report if the repository's convention is that entries accumulate under `[Unreleased]`.

rules.statement: Don't report a repeated read of a file or store as redundant when a call between the reads may have rewritten it; the later read is needed to see the updated content.
rules.why: Reusing the earlier read would use stale data that misses what the intervening call wrote.
rules.check: Before reporting a duplicate read, check whether any call between the reads writes to the same file or store; if so, the re-read is correct.
